<?svml using="@hypit/markup@1"?>
<svml>
 <import as="time" from="@hypit/timeline-author@1"/><import as="space" from="@hypit/spatial@1"/>
 <import as="asset" from="@hypit/media@1"/><import as="film" from="@hypit/film@1"/>
 <import as="render" from="@hypit/render-hyperframes@1"/><import as="look" source="./look.svs"/>
 <import as="motion" from="@frame/swiss-poster@1"/>
 <time:Clock id="clock" frame-rate="24"/><time:Timeline id="program" clock={clock} end="44s"/>
 <space:Canvas id="canvas" width="960" height="540"/>
 <asset:Font id="font" src="./assets/FrameSans-Regular.otf" weight="400" style="normal"/>
 <asset:Font id="archivo" src="./packages/frame--swiss-poster-1.0.0/fonts/Archivo-VF.ttf" weight="400" style="normal"/>
 <asset:Font id="fraktur" src="./packages/frame--swiss-poster-1.0.0/fonts/UnifrakturMaguntia-Regular.ttf" weight="400" style="normal"/>
 <asset:Font id="serif" src="./packages/frame--swiss-poster-1.0.0/fonts/DMSerifDisplay-Regular.ttf" weight="400" style="normal"/>
 <motion:Motion id="effect" timeline={program.timeline} canvas={canvas} font={font} archivo={archivo} fraktur={fraktur} serif={serif} start="0s" end="44s"/>
 <film:Film id="main" canvas={canvas} timeline={program.timeline} appearance={look.film.main}><film:Track source={effect.track}/></film:Film>
 <render:Video id="final" composition={main.composition} timeline={program.timeline}/>
</svml>
